annotations.title: Find clothes that look like a picture

description: Wardrobe Connect. Find clothes that look like a picture. For when the user shares or points at a picture of an outfit or item (a Pinterest pin, a saved post, a photo). Takes the image's direct https link. Returns visually similar eBay listings from the Clothing, Shoes and Accessories category only, in eBay's look-alike order. If the picture does not look like one piece of clothing (the results are scattered across unrelated kinds), `matches` is empty and the say line asks what the item is. A short description in q makes results match it, which removes look-alikes of the wrong kind.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the eBay site and currency, for example US or GB.

image_url.description: Direct https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP picture, 6 MB at most.

max_price.description: Highest price, in the local currency.

q.description: Which item in the picture, for example "the camel coat". Results must match it, and it is used as a fallback text search.

size.description: Clothing or shoe size to match, for example M, 10 or UK 8.

name: wardrobeconnect_find_clothes_by_image
